sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: This page explains our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information we receive from users of our website.

sections.heading: Use of Personal Information
sections.content: We use your personal information to provide, maintain, and improve our website and services. By using our website, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Information Collection
sections.content: While using our website, we may ask you to provide certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you. This information may include your name, email address, contact number, and other relevant details.

sections.heading: Log Data
sections.content: We collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our website. This log data may include your computer's Internet Protocol (IP) address, browser type, browser version, the pages you visit, the date and time of your visit, the time spent on those pages, and other related statistics.

sections.heading: Analytics Services
sections.content: We may use third-party services, such as Google Analytics, to collect, monitor, and analyze website usage information to help us understand and improve our services.

sections.heading: Communication and Marketing
sections.content: We may use your personal information to contact you by email, send newsletters, share updates, and provide marketing materials related to our services.

sections.heading: Information Security
sections.content: The security of your personal information is important to us. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure. Although we strive to use commercially acceptable measures to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.content: Cookies are small files containing a limited amount of data, which may include an anonymous unique identifier. Cookies are sent to your browser by a website and stored on your device. Like many websites, we may use cookies to collect information and improve your browsing experience. You can configure your browser to reject all cookies or notify you when a cookie is being sent.

sections.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: This Privacy Policy is effective as of January 1, 2026, and will remain in effect unless updated or amended. We reserve the right to update or change this policy at any time. You should review this page periodically for changes. Any modifications will become effective once posted on this page. Your continued use of our website or services after changes are posted constitutes your acknowledgment of the revised policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the contact details provided on our website.
